findings.title: The finite flat-current formula omits the initial offset
operative_hypotheses: L=dN, integer d>=2, 0<=delta<d; initial configuration delta,d+delta,...,(N-1)d+delta
p,q>=0, p+q=1; time t>=0; integer local-current threshold a
Counterexample L=6,N=2,d=3,a=1 satisfies strict contour density 2N<L
Q_5 is net current at the fixed edge 5→0, not a simultaneously translated edge

evidence.proved_counterexample: For p=1,q=0, from (1,4) exactly one shortest two-transition path 4→5→0 yields P(Q5>=1)=t^2/2+O(t^3). From (0,3) the particle at0 must vacate and the other makes three jumps3→4→5→0; three allowed interleavings yield3t^4/4!=t^4/8+O(t^5). RHS of(5.37) with(5.34)–(5.36) contains no delta, so cannot equal both.
evidence.strictly_positive_rates: Exact rational generator powers through order6 give coefficients1/128 of t^4 fordelta0 and1/8 of t^2 fordelta1 whenp=q=1/2.
evidence.proof_basis: Finite continuous-time generator Taylor expansion on configuration/current states; all transition rates finite. No author code.

findings.core_dependency: Proposition5.4 is the exact starting formula for flat asymptotics inSection5.2 andTheorem3.13.
alternate_readings_and_counterevidence: Spatial translation also translates the observed edge, so it does not repair the fixed-edge finite-time assertion.
The derivation onpp60–61 retains w^(1+delta),v^(-N+delta+2),andv^(L-N-Q+delta), supplying the missing factors.
For fixed d, conservation bounds the difference of currents at edges delta apart bydelta; this vanishes after sqrt(L) scaling, so asymptotic offset independence is not refuted.
findings.repair: Necessary factors C_delta=C_0 product_{v in Q1(z)}v^delta and f_delta(w)=w^delta f_0(w); every other determinant normalization has not been fully rederived.
findings.impact: The stated exact finite-time proposition is false. No claim that Theorem3.13 or the whole paper is false.

findings.title: The step-limit kernel definition differs from the proof
operative_hypotheses: All denominators nonzero since every root has negative real part

evidence.formula: Definition(3.41) has Psi(xi1)+Psi(xi2); p70 proof has Phi(xi1)+Phi(eta), with Phi=Psi+H and H the negative Li_{1/2} primitive.
evidence.analytic_inequality: e^(2x)K_def(-1,xi2)→0 as x→+infinity because Re(xi2)<-1 and its eta series is absolutely summable of order |eta|^-3. e^(2x)K_proof(-1,xi2)→exp(2/3+4H(-1))/[-2(xi2-1)]!=0, from the unique maximal-real-part root eta=-1. Other roots have Reeta<-1, Reeta^3 positive of cubic order, H(eta)=O(1/|eta|), providing a summable majorant.
evidence.independent_proof: Root parametrization and dominated convergence proved in report Section3; not reported as a numerical computation.

findings.title: Ordinary particle–hole duality does not justify the high-density extension

independent_acceptance_check.scope: One focused independent check of existing findings; not a new full-paper review.

problem_checks.decisive_check: The generator explicitly allows p1,q0, and(5.30) allows both delta0 and1 at L6,N2,d3. At fixed edge5, initial(1,4) has exactly one length2 positive-current path4->5->0, coefficient1/2. From(0,3), particle0 must vacate before the three-jump crossing3->4->5->0; exactly3 shortest length4 interleavings give3/4!=1/8. Finite rates justify the leading Taylor terms. With p=q1/2 the same shortest right-only paths give1/8 and1/128, matching the retained exact Fraction output. Equations5.34-5.36 contain no delta, so one RHS cannot match both laws.
problem_checks.counterevidence_and_scope: Read the actual derivation5.38-5.39 and p61: delta factors persist, requiring product v^delta in C and w^delta in f. This validates necessary repairs, not every other normalization. Translation also changes the observed edge. Current differences between edges delta apart are bounded by delta via arc occupancy, so after sqrtL scaling no asymptotic counterexample follows. The exact finite-time Proposition5.4 used in the core flat derivation is false as stated and warrants Major.

problem_checks.decisive_check: Actual page27(3.41) has Psi(xi1)+Psi(xi2), while page70 has Phi(xi1)+Phi(eta), and Phi has twice the primitive coefficient. At z=e^-1/2,tau1,gamma0,xi1=-1,xi2=-sqrt(1+4pi i), the first kernel times e^(2x) tends0 because its remaining eta-series is O(sum |eta|^-3). For the proof kernel, eta=-1 is the unique root with maximal real part and leaves exp(2/3+4H(-1))/[-2(xi2-1)] nonzero. Other roots have strictly smaller real parts, positive cubic real part eventually and H=O(1/|eta|): along a horizontal left contour the polylog series is bounded by C_z exp(-Re(w^2)/2), giving the stated primitive bound and summable domination.
problem_checks.counterevidence_and_scope: Independently read Baik-Liu physical pp11-12: equations4.11-4.12 agree with the acquired paper proof. Unequal kernels do not alone establish unequal contour-integrated determinants. A local formula repair already in the proof suffices for this identified discrepancy; no corrected limit theorem falsity or complete steepest-descent certification claimed.

problem_checks.decisive_check: At L5,N2,Y=X=(0,1),p1,q0,t0 there is one allowed departure so the actual diagonal derivative is-1. Periodicity makes the other incoming configuration(-1,1) distinct fromY. Printed g(0,0)=g(0,1)=1 then gives free derivative zeta-2, unequal at zeta=i. Algebraically a_j=1-1/(zeta w_j) gives u_adj=zeta u_coll, so the required boundary is g_coll=zeta^-1 g_adj.
problem_checks.counterevidence_and_scope: AppendixB.1 explicitly states and proves the corrected factor; zeta1 is unaffected. The sample w1,w2 are not asserted Bethe roots. Correcting the local rule removes the displayed obstruction without refuting the final eigenfunction statement.

problem_checks.decisive_check: Source p13-14 explicitly uses post-change w=zeta*w_old. Multiplying(2.31) cancels ratios and sign(-1)^(N(N-1)), giving(product w)^L=zeta^(LN). L3,N1,zeta=w1=i,z^3=1-i satisfies both nonzero decoupled equations, with w1^3=-i, not1.
problem_checks.counterevidence_and_scope: The corrected root-unity statement applies to zeta^-N productw. Since |zeta|1, product|w|1 survives and is the actual quantity used in the subsequent size and small-z arguments. Generic-zeta exceptions remain intact; this does not refute their theorem at excluded parameters.

problem_checks.result: Verified as a bounded justification gap; Minor retained
problem_checks.decisive_check: The actual contour beta1 interval is nonempty only for2N<L; p39 and AppendixA address equality. For L4,N3,q1 with hole0, the three source-generator push clocks produce holes at1,2,3 each at rate1. A one-particle nearest-neighbor PushASEP has no transition0->2, even after reflection. This obstruction remains for q>0.
problem_checks.counterevidence_and_scope: Remark2.5 provides no transformed generator/current formula. The check rules out ordinary complement/reflection as the asserted automatic extension, not every possible algebraic duality or a direct proof. At q0 TASEP the usual symmetry works. Full occupancy has no allowed generator move and needs separate treatment. Low-density formulas and fluctuation conclusions are not refuted.
